siteOff.stops: Switching Inventory sync off for this site stops its stock counts, products and paid orders syncing with Cin7 Core, inFlow, Brightpearl or Ordoro.

siteOff.keeps: The connections are kept, and the site’s browser tags on the Tracking tab are not affected.
siteOff.stops: Switching Ad conversions off for this site stops its purchases and leads being sent to the Meta, TikTok and Pinterest accounts it connected.

POS_OFFLINE_FLAG_LABELS.price-changed: A price changed after the register cached it; the sale kept the price it was rung at
POS_OFFLINE_FLAG_LABELS.register-over-cap: The register it was rung on is over the plan’s register limit
POS_OFFLINE_FLAG_LABELS.shift-closed: Rung in a shift that closed before the sale synced; its Z report does not include it
POS_OFFLINE_FLAG_LABELS.stock-short: Stock went short: more was sold than the shelf held
POS_OFFLINE_FLAG_LABELS.tax-differs: The tax rung differs from the store’s rate now; the sale kept the tax it collected
POS_OFFLINE_FLAG_LABELS.totals-restated: The register’s totals did not add up; the server restated them from the lines
POS_OFFLINE_FLAG_LABELS.unknown-product: A product was deleted before the sale synced; the line kept what the receipt printed
POS_OFFLINE_FLAG_LABELS.unknown-register: The register it was rung on no longer exists
